pending_decision: User clarification of portfolio 100-percent/raw-versus-normalized weight policy. No policy change is made by this draft.
scope: Preserve all six experiment types, funds, arms and three-stage workflows; reduce scenarios and generation replicates only. This is an amended exploratory design, not completion of the original confirmatory v6.3 design.

selection_rules.main: For each original precision(.5,1,2) x original replacement target(F01..F04) cell, choose its numerically earliest main scenario ID; retain the original subset execution order and replicate1. Do not regenerate targets on a shortened scenario list.
selection_rules.counterfactual: Keep the original one target fund and original replacement signal corresponding to each selected main scenario; run R1/R3/C-context once and compare to the same original main input.
selection_rules.development: Use the first three frozen development scenarios, one per precision. The existing001 responses remain prior development proof.
selection_rules.negative_control: Use the first original scenario for each base fund. Preserve source=(scenario index-1)%4 and identical information/holdings/constraints across four virtual labels. Do not create four different-fund treatments.
selection_rules.negative_control_precision_caution: First four original NC cases have precisions .5/1/2/.5, not a balanced precision sample. Selection preserves all four source funds; do not claim NC precision balance.
selection_rules.A_C: Retain both actual-document modules, all four funds and all five arms; retain original replicate1 only.
selection_rules.selection_inputs: Frozen source code, fixed seeds, schedule labels/precision/target metadata and engineering cost evidence only. No effect estimates, p-values or portfolio outcome values used.

legacy_evidence.pending_policy_caution: Existing001 proves only its original raw-output policy. It does not certify a new normalization policy. If the resolved policy needs new compatibility tests, additional work must be declared separately; do not relabel old responses.

alternative_N6.selection_rule: Among the earliest representatives of the 12 precision-target cells, choose two cells per precision covering all four target funds overall; choose the lexicographically earliest sorted scenario-ID tuple.
alternative_N6.reason_not_preferred: Cannot retain all twelve precision-by-target-fund cells even though all experiment types and four target funds remain represented.

conditional_costs.method: Future count x measured stabilized mean; upper uses B-family x empirical P90 x1.2, A/C x P90 x1.2 x1.5, plus shared preparation/analysis planning allowances 2.5..10h.
limitations: Not a statistical interval or a guarantee. Only one development scenario measured.
A/C full rendered histories have not been measured; exact capacity checks remain required.
Changed weight policy or additional compatibility checks can change runtime.
Tool rounds, retries, cold loading, thermal/power interruptions and unmeasured numerical preparation may exceed estimates.
Past60 requests remain in the original cost ledger; they are not new future requests.

remaining_before_execution: Resolve and explicitly record the weight policy; preserve original raw responses.
Review and freeze the new amendment, selected metadata/input hashes and exploratory analysis scope.
Implement a separate runner/evaluator and new identity; keep candidate005 CORE/config/ledger unchanged.
Verify exact A/C rendered input capacity, scenario/CF input equality, accounting and recovery with no model calls first.
Use a separate live run lock and avoid concurrent campaigns sharing the model server.
